Emma (CSM): Heads-up — CobaltOps renewal is ready but procurement hit a billing-entity mismatch and the sig is blocked because the authorized signer is OOO until Tue. Trying to avoid slipping to next quarter. Any quick workarounds? :thinking_face:
Maria (CobaltOps): Sorry, that's on us. Our procurement team says invoices need to be issued to our EU entity (CobaltOps EU Ltd) but our legal signatory is in the US entity. They need vendor code and VAT info aligned.
Ryan (Finance): Two quick options: 1) they provide a PO for the EU entity now (`PO-987654-EU`) and we issue invoice to EU; legal signature can follow under the holding company, or 2) we do a single-signature order form now to the US entity and add an invoice addendum to route billing to the EU entity. Both require CLARIFICATION around tax/VAT.
Joseph (Legal): We can prepare a short billing-addendum that doesn't change commercial terms, just invoice recipient and VAT details. Need a one-paragraph description and the ship-to/bill-to entity names. If they want vendor code, ask procurement to confirm the code string.
Emma (CSM): @Maria can you confirm the exact invoice entity name + VAT ID and whether procurement will accept an addendum? If yes, we'll send AF (addendum + OF) for e-sign now.
Maria (CobaltOps): Confirmed: Billing entity: CobaltOps EU Ltd, VAT: GB123456789. Procurement can accept an addendum, but they prefer DocuSign. Signer (N. Patel) is OOO until Tue but can delegate to finance on a limited basis.
Aisha (Enablement): Quick note — if we sign now and billing clears, can we still lock in the onboarding kickoff next week? Customer is asking for role-based enablement sessions for infra and app teams.
Emma (CSM): Yes — we usually schedule enablement conditional on executed order. If we can get e-sign today or Monday, I can book Aisha's slots for the week after. Otherwise we push back.
Ryan (Finance): If they provide `PO-987654-EU` today and confirm delegation in writing, finance is comfortable issuing invoices to the EU entity. I'll need the PO PDF + contact email for AP.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope 0x8b3f sent to maria@cobaltops.com for signature (CobaltOps billing addendum).
Maria (CobaltOps): I forwarded the PO PDF and delegation note to emma@redwood.com. Delegation email attached — Netsignature approval from finance is fine.
Joseph (Legal): Drafted addendum; it says: "This Addendum updates the invoicing entity to CobaltOps EU Ltd (VAT GB123456789). All other terms remain unchanged." Putting it in DocuSign now.
Emma (CSM): Thanks. Action items: 1) Joseph to complete addendum in DocuSign (in progress), 2) Maria to confirm PO + delegation (done), 3) Ryan to flag AP contact for invoice, 4) Aisha to tentatively reserve enablement slots week-of next Mon. I'll update the renewal tracker and flag as "at risk -> mitigated". :white_check_mark:
Aisha (Enablement): Tentative hold set for Tue/Wed next week 10–12 and 2–4 PT. I need final confirmation 48h before to assign trainers.
Emma (CSM): Capture feedback from procurement: they asked for clearer vendor-code process. Can we add a short paragraph to onboarding docs outlining vendor-code and invoice entity flow? @Aisha / @Ryan thoughts.
Ryan (Finance): Yep — I'll draft a short note we can surface in the welcome pack. Helps reduce back-and-forth for future renewals.
Maria (CobaltOps): Signed — I completed the DocuSign envelope as delegated by finance. Let me know when invoice is issued and I will confirm with AP.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope 0x8b3f completed by maria@cobaltops.com at 2456791000.
Emma (CSM): Great — Ryan, can you confirm invoicing schedule? If we can invoice this month to CobaltOps EU Ltd we keep the renewal in current quarter.
Ryan (Finance): Confirmed. I'll issue the invoice dated today to CobaltOps EU Ltd, referencing `PO-987654-EU`. Expect PDF to be uploaded to the customer record within 24h.
Emma (CSM): Perfect. I'll move the opportunity to "Closed — signed" in the tracker and send kickoff calendar invites to Maria & Aisha once invoice lands. Closing note: procurement suggested a small improvement to reduce friction — add a vendor-code checklist to the PO/Invoice section of the renewal playbook. Filing that as a feedback item.
Maria (CobaltOps): Appreciate the quick turn. Also flagged onboarding topics to my ops team — will share attendee list by EOD.
Emma (CSM): Thanks team. Closing thread — will post final artifacts to the renewal folder and ping legal/finance if anything else pops up. :rocket:
